rules.source: roadmap e5ab95d650 (Test SCL), set before any result; same form as SC's scorecard with L (VL's lr 1e-4 night) in W1's place
rules.gain: gain = C2 DEV first try minus N' first try (points); ratio = SCL gain / L gain
rules.passes: on BOTH parents: harm_measure(N' DEV hits, SCL DEV hits) passes (in_dist drop <= 1.5, no family fires) and first-try gain over N' >= 0.9x L's gain
rules.near_miss: as in SC: a shortfall of exactly ONE DEV question counts as met; two or more fails (questions_short is reported)
rules.proved_wrong: harm fails on EITHER parent, or gain < 0.5x L's on BOTH parents
rules.report_only: SCL - L and SCL - W1 first try (paired boot), multi-step reach@32 SCL - L and SCL - W1, in_dist drop SCL vs L, harm SCL vs L and vs W1, harm vs B2, picked family mix, loss rise picked vs random, CPU seconds

recipe: night 1 from N' = VL's arm L exactly (W1's records, lr 1e-4, 32 visits, W1's seed, warm replay, schedule) with ONE change, SC's: after the first 32 updates, every 32 updates 1,024 fresh skills TRAIN rows are scored (loss now - loss of the frozen pre-night N'), the 256 with the largest rise are the skills replay of the next 32 updates. Control = VL's L (uniform replay), already trained
